title: EasyFAB project registration IPC v1
description: projects_overview returns overview; create_project accepts {input: new_project} and returns projects.schema.json#/$defs/project. Errors are strings. Overview requires a revalidated normal Admin/Supervisor session and the active workspace. Creation requires the sole active Supervisor account in the confirmed four-account workflow; Admin manages accounts and reads projects. Multiple active Supervisors block creation. No caller-supplied paths or identity; no per-machine or per-user build authorization. One working session per account is an operating precondition, not distributed exclusion guaranteed by OneDrive.
